strings.title: The Last-Hour Will
strings.hint: Who lost out under the new amendment? And search the fireplaces: burned paper confesses through its surviving edges.
strings.solvedText:
The culprit: the eldest son, Ghassan Al-Hashem.

Listening at the door, he learned that his father had summoned the lawyer for dawn to cut him out of the will after his latest gambling scandal, in favor of the nurse he had raised and who had faithfully cared for him. Ghassan entered his father's suite after midnight "to reconcile." When he saw the draft amendment on the table, he smothered his sleeping father with a pillow, took the draft, and burned it in his own fireplace… incompletely.

Pillow fibers on his nightshirt, the surviving draft fragments from his fireplace explicitly stating his disinheritance, and the maid's testimony about the "last-hour" argument proved his guilt.
strings.summary.text: At the Al-Hashem mansion, family patriarch Jaber Al-Hashem (78 years old) was found dead in bed on the morning he was due to sign a radical amendment to his will. Death seemed natural for a man his age, except for the tiny hemorrhagic spots in his eyes, a sign forensic examiners recognized: smothering with a pillow. The new draft of the will was missing, and the lawyer swore it had been on the suite's table that night.

strings.summary.victim.name: Jaber Al-Hashem
strings.summary.timeline[0].l: He calls the lawyer: "Tomorrow we sign the amendment"
strings.summary.timeline[1].l: A muffled argument in his suite (the maid's testimony)
strings.scene.intro: No disturbance or forced entry: the killer lives in the mansion. The second pillow lies on the floor beside the bed, the draft the lawyer left on the table is missing, and fresh paper ash is found in the east wing fireplace, in the eldest son's suite.

strings.evidence[0].title: The Second Pillow
strings.evidence[0].desc: Its fine feather fibers were found on the eldest son's nightshirt.
strings.evidence[1].title: Burned Draft Fragments
strings.evidence[1].desc: The surviving clause is legible: "…Ghassan shall be deprived of his entire share in favor of…"
strings.evidence[2].title: Last-Hour Testimony
strings.evidence[2].desc: A muffled argument at 23:30: the victim's voice says, "My decision is final, boy," followed by a door slamming.
strings.evidence[3].title: Gambling Debts
strings.evidence[3].desc: Ghassan's latest debts run into millions, and his creditors are not the sort who wait.
strings.evidence[4].title: The Old Will
strings.evidence[4].desc: Still valid because he died before signing: Ghassan inherits a full half.
strings.evidence[5].title: Nighttime Doses
strings.evidence[5].desc: The nurse gave him his usual sleeping pill at 22:00. He was deeply asleep two hours before his killer arrived.
strings.suspects[0].name: Ghassan Al-Hashem
strings.suspects[0].job: Eldest son — manager of the family estates
strings.suspects[0].alibi: "I said goodnight to my father while he was well and went to my suite. The whole mansion was asleep."
strings.suspects[0].statement: My father rebuked me for gambling that night and was harsh. He had that right, and I accepted it. But he was my father. In our family, wills are discussed over lunch, not enforced with pillows. My fireplace? I burn my debt papers every night so I can sleep.
strings.suspects[1].name: Nurse Salma Wakim
strings.suspects[1].relation: The main beneficiary of the amendment
strings.suspects[1].alibi: "I gave him his medication at ten and slept in my adjoining room. I heard the argument and stayed out of it out of respect."
strings.suspects[1].statement: I cared for him like a father for nine years and never asked for anything. When he told me about the amendment, I cried and begged him to wait so the family would not turn against me. His death before signing was my loss. The old will does not mention my name once.
strings.suspects[2].name: Lawyer Nabil Harfoush
strings.suspects[2].relation: Drafted the amendment and held the copies
strings.suspects[2].alibi: "I left the mansion at half past ten after delivering the draft. The gate camera confirms it."
strings.suspects[2].statement: I gave him the draft to read on his final night, as he requested. The formal original remained in my safe, as professional practice requires. Whoever burned the draft burned a paper with no legal value, but exposed himself. Only one member of this family knows the law… unfortunately, he did not know it well enough.
strings.witnesses[0].name: Umm Joseph, the Maid
strings.witnesses[0].statement: I heard my employer say, "My decision is final, boy." He only calls Ghassan "boy," even when he is pleased with him.
strings.witnesses[1].name: Driver
strings.witnesses[1].statement: I took Mr. Nabil to the gate at twenty past ten and heard him say on the phone: "He'll sign in the morning, and the eldest boy's nonsense will end."
strings.witnesses[2].name: Gardener
strings.witnesses[2].statement: The east wing chimney was smoking around one in the morning, on a summer night that needed no fire.
strings.folders[0].name: Incident reports
strings.folders[0].docs[0].title: Death Notification
strings.folders[0].docs[0].body: An apparently natural death report became a criminal investigation following the forensic examiner's initial observations.
strings.folders[1].name: Forensic evidence
strings.folders[1].docs[0].title: Smothering Report
strings.folders[1].docs[0].body: Smothering with a pillow during deep, medicated sleep. The victim offered almost no resistance.
strings.folders[1].docs[1].title: Fiber Report
strings.folders[1].docs[1].body: Feather fibers from the second pillow were found on Ghassan's nightshirt, specifically on his sleeves.
strings.folders[2].name: Interviews
strings.folders[2].docs[0].title: Ghassan Interview
strings.folders[2].docs[0].body: He admitted the argument but denied returning to the suite. He could not explain the draft fragments in his fireplace.
strings.folders[2].docs[1].title: Nurse Interview
strings.folders[2].docs[1].body: Her account was consistent. Her bedroom door creaks loudly, as confirmed in a nighttime test, and nobody heard it open after the argument.
strings.folders[2].docs[2].title: Lawyer Interview
strings.folders[2].docs[2].body: His departure was documented. He handed the formal original of the old will and the unsigned new one to the prosecution.
strings.folders[3].name: Records
strings.folders[3].docs[0].title: Ghassan's Debt Record
strings.folders[3].docs[0].body: Two final notices from "private" creditors, due at the end of the month. The old will was his only lifeline.
strings.folders[3].docs[1].title: Corridor Camera Log
strings.folders[3].docs[1].body: A "coincidental" failure of the main suite corridor camera began at 23:00. Its breaker had been disconnected at a panel only household members knew.
strings.folders[4].name: Confidential files
strings.folders[4].docs[0].title: The Complete Surviving Clause
strings.folders[4].docs[0].body: Reconstruction of the burned fragments: "…Ghassan shall be deprived of his entire share in favor of a care fund managed by Salma Wakim, in gratitude for nine years of loyalty."
strings.folders[4].docs[1].title: Confrontation Record
strings.folders[4].docs[1].body: Confronted with the reconstructed clause and the fibers, Ghassan broke down: "I wanted to reconcile… then I found my name erased. I didn't plan it. My hands moved before my mind." The court will decide how much weight those words carry.
strings.reports[0].title: The Night of the Will Report
strings.reports[0].author: Investigation team
strings.reports[0].body: Death before a signature that would change everything means a motive as large as the estate. The internally disabled camera and summer fireplace narrow the culprit to the mansion's residents.
strings.reports[1].title: The Losing Beneficiary Report
strings.reports[1].author: Assigned investigator
strings.reports[1].body: The irony: the new beneficiary lost through the premature death, while the old heir gained. The direction of the benefit, rather than its size, exposed the killer.
strings.notes[0].text: He died before signing. Who was saved by his early death?
strings.notes[1].text: A chimney smoking in summer = burning paper
